creativeThesis: Resolve a familiar tactile mystery through a close physical encounter, then replay the contact with its anticipation made visible.
viewerExperience: Another hand touches and the torso recoils slightly; own connected arm produces a smaller reaction. Close skin reveals anticipation, contact and a smaller nonzero ripple. A real experimental delay disrupts the correspondence; the opening action returns understood.
emotionalTarget: Familiarity, surprise and an honest insight into how action shapes sensation.
visualThesis: Hands and skin carry the explanation: a future contact impression appears before actual contact, which remains felt. No static brain or branch diagram.
